comment: Complete inventory of optional document-icon themes. Every entry is built only from preserved artwork at the pinned archive commits. The bundled default (refined C · Seal Dark, build 26501) is not a downloadable pack. Theme ids are stable; bump a theme's version only when its pack contents change.

default.name: Seal Dark
default.source: main Resources/DocumentIcons (build 26501, losslessly optimized; pixels pinned by PIXELS.sha256)

licence: Original Arkiv artwork, distributed for use with Arkiv. Arkiv has not yet selected a project licence; no other licence is granted. Labels are rendered from Inter Display 4.0 (SIL Open Font License 1.1); the rendered images are not Font Software under that licence.
